suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the locale-fix exception for redesign workers: when a follow-up or parity-repair task is assigned to ui-worker and only translation coverage is missing, the worker may edit locale files needed to satisfy the fix instead of treating i18n keys as categorically off-limits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The passing fix feature `fix-en-farms-summary-keys` was routed through `ui-worker`, but its work was solely adding missing `en.ts` translation keys. The review report notes `.factory/skills/ui-worker/SKILL.md` still forbids changing i18n keys even though this mission repeatedly required locale-file edits to close scrutiny blockers.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax the locale-parity rule for targeted repair work: require all locales when introducing a brand-new key, but allow single-locale follow-up fixes when the other locales already contain the needed keys.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The rerun fix needed to add `farms.summary.*` only in `src/i18n/locales/en.ts` because `hi.ts` and `mr.ts` already had those keys from the previous commit. The current mission guidance says new keys must be added to all three locale files together, which conflicts with valid parity-repair work and caused repeated scrutiny churn.
